elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party claims alleging that the services infringe intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: Clause (iii) covers systems, software, reports and other deliverables, but does not cover infringement arising from the services themselves.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party claims alleging that the deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: Clause (iii) requires each Servicer and Marketing Agent to indemnify the Issuer against third-party claims that its systems, software, reports or other deliverables infringe any intellectual property right.

elements.element: Customer affiliates receive the benefit of all required Vendor indemnities.
elements.evidence: The IP indemnity protects only the Issuer. The other named Indemnified Persons are trustees and specified representatives, not expressly the Issuer's affiliates.

elements.element: Vendor has a mandatory duty to defend Customer and its affiliates against covered third-party claims.
elements.evidence: The clause reimburses defense costs and permits the indemnifying party to assume a defense, but it does not impose an affirmative duty to defend.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party claims arising from Vendor's breach of law.
elements.evidence: No standalone indemnity trigger covers breach of law.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party claims arising from a data breach caused by Vendor.
elements.evidence: No standalone indemnity trigger covers a data breach caused by the Servicer or Marketing Agent.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party claims arising from Vendor's gross negligence.
elements.evidence: Clauses (i) and (ii) indemnify the Issuer and other Indemnified Persons for claims and liabilities resulting from the applicable indemnitor's gross negligence in performing its obligations.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party claims arising from Vendor's wilful misconduct.
elements.evidence: Clauses (i) and (ii) indemnify the Issuer and other Indemnified Persons for claims and liabilities resulting from the applicable indemnitor's willful misconduct.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires prompt notice of a covered proceeding, subject to a customary prejudice limitation.
elements.evidence: Section (b) requires prompt notice and provides that failure to notify affects indemnification only to the extent it prejudices the relevant rights.

elements.element: The indemnifying Vendor has the right to control the defense and settlement of a covered proceeding.
elements.evidence: Section (b) permits the applicable Servicer or Marketing Agent to participate in and assume the defense and settlement at its expense.

elements.element: Customer must provide reasonable cooperation in the defense of a covered proceeding.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no cooperation obligation.

elements.element: Customer indemnifies Vendor against third-party claims arising from Customer-provided content.
elements.evidence: No indemnity from the Issuer to the Servicer or Marketing Agent is included.

elements.element: Customer indemnifies Vendor against third-party claims arising from Customer's breach of law.
elements.evidence: No indemnity from the Issuer for its breach of law is included.

elements.element: Any Customer indemnity is limited exclusively to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause imposes no Customer indemnity at all, so it demonstrably does not impose any broader Customer indemnity trigger; the affirmative reciprocal duties are separately absent.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property-infringement claims involving Vendor-provided items.
elements.evidence: Clause (iii) indemnifies the Issuer against third-party claims that systems, software, reports or other deliverables provided by the applicable Servicer or Marketing Agent infringe any intellectual property right.

elements.element: The Vendor IP indemnity excludes claims arising from Customer modifications.
elements.evidence: Clause (iii) excludes claims to the extent arising from modifications made by the Issuer.

elements.element: The Vendor IP indemnity excludes claims arising from Customer combinations with items not supplied by Vendor.
elements.evidence: Clause (iii) excludes claims arising from the Issuer's combination of covered items with items not supplied by the Servicer or Marketing Agent.

elements.element: The Vendor IP indemnity excludes claims arising from Customer specifications.
elements.evidence: Clause (iii) expressly excludes claims arising from the Issuer's specifications.

elements.element: Vendor must procure the right to continue using an affected item as an infringement remedy.
elements.evidence: Clause (iii) requires the applicable indemnitor to procure the right to continue using the affected item.

elements.element: Vendor may satisfy the infringement remedy by modifying the affected item to make it non-infringing.
elements.evidence: Clause (iii) expressly provides for modification so that the affected item is non-infringing.

elements.element: Vendor may satisfy the infringement remedy by replacing the affected item with a non-infringing item.
elements.evidence: Clause (iii) expressly provides for replacement so that the affected item is non-infringing.

elements.element: Vendor must refund the fees paid for the affected item if procurement, modification and replacement are unavailable on commercially reasonable terms.
elements.evidence: Clause (iii) requires a refund of fees paid for the affected item if the other stated remedies are unavailable on commercially reasonable terms.

elements.element: A dedicated super-cap applies to the Vendor IP indemnity.
elements.evidence: Clause (iii) expressly caps aggregate liability under that IP-indemnity clause.

elements.element: The Vendor IP-indemnity super-cap is three times annual fees.
elements.evidence: The cap is stated as 3x the annual fees payable to the applicable indemnitor under the Transaction Documents.

result.reason: The operative addition satisfies the fallback through an Issuer-facing third-party IP indemnity, all three specified exclusions, the procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and a 3x annual-fees cap. It does not satisfy the preferred position because it omits service-level infringement coverage, affiliates, a mandatory defense duty, breach-of-law and Vendor-caused-data-breach triggers, cooperation, and the affirmative Customer indemnities. Drafting is understandable but weakened by placing clause (iii) after subsection (b), the ambiguous antecedent of “In that event,” and the singular “it” in a cap described as aggregate liability of two separate indemnitors.
